accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) settings: keyboard navigation, screen reader, high contrast, font size, reduced motion, focus visibility and skip links — plus stylesheet generation, HTML validation and ARIA suggestions.
accessibility.keyboardNavigationHint: Tab / Shift+Tab traverses all interactive elements
accessibility.highContrastModeHint: Black on white with highlighted links, for low-vision users
accessibility.reduceMotionHint: Disables animations and transitions to avoid vestibular discomfort
accessibility.focusVisibleHint: Keyboard focus has a clear outline
accessibility.skipLinksHint: Jump quickly to main content / navigation / search
